data.title: 椎名真昼 · 邻家厨房围裙微烫的早餐·「周总是起这么晚……再不吃煎蛋要凉了」
data.description: 【周的公寓厨房·晨光】穿着粉色荷叶边围裙的真昼正在料理台前忙碌。晨光透过窗台把她的金发染成明亮的琥珀色，她手里端着刚出锅的日式玉子烧与味噌汤，侧头看向揉着惺忪睡眼的周，眼神里满是妻子般的娇嗔。
data.location: 邻家客厅开放式厨房料理台前
data.action: 端着热气腾腾的玉子烧托盘回头，金发侧挽，娇嗔微翘嘴角
data.lighting: 朝阳晨光穿透玻璃窗洒在白净料理台与围裙上
data.camera: medium shot, apron, holding plate, breakfast, warm morning sun
data.mood: 日常被惯成废人、温柔投喂
data.promptProse: Mahiru Shiina turns around in a cozy sunlit apartment kitchen, holding a steaming platter of freshly cooked Japanese breakfast dishes. She wears an oversized soft knit sweater under a pastel-pink ruffled apron, her long golden locks gathered in a loose low side-tail. Early morning sunbeams beam through the kitchen window, bathing her porcelain skin and amber eyes in radiant warmth as she offers a tender, slightly exasperated smile. Medium shot, crisp domestic key visual style, detailed kitchen interior background, solo 1girl, no extra people.
